facts.text: Tim mentioned he gave a presentation in class and felt it was a small step toward progress.

evidence.quote: Yesterday, I tackled something new - I gave a presentation in class. I was nervous but I made it. Small step, but feels like progress.

facts.text: John shared that he made a soup without a specific recipe, describing it as 'real good'.

evidence.quote: Made this tasty soup recently - it was real good!
I just sort of made it up on the spot so I don't have a recipe.
